ruleDefinitions.name: Ufw Force Stop Using Ufw-Init
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to force stop the ufw using ufw-init

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ufw\\-init.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*force\\-stop.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ufw.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*disable.*")))
